scope_boundary: finite-dimensional exact theorem; functional use additionally requires closed range, a common product domain, uniform positivity and boundary maximality

theorem.ambient_rank_floor: rank Q >= dim ker H-rank d
theorem.euler_factor_consequence: Q=L H has rank(Q|ker H)=0 and can pass only if ker H=im d
theorem.restricted_kernel: ker(Q restricted to ker H)=im d
